relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN. The seeded id was zagier2010, whose ref() entry (references.ts:356) is a conference-proceedings chapter on quantum modular forms. This document is a 2022/2024 single-author research article, arXiv:2205.01282v2 [math.GT], proving a conjecture of Gukov-Pei-Putrov-Vafa for a wide class of plumbed 3-manifolds: that WRT invariants are radial limits of the homological blocks (q-series for plumbed 3-manifolds with negative-definite linking matrices), with the hard step being the vanishing of weighted Gauss sums in the negative-degree coefficients of the asymptotic expansions, handled by a new technique comparing asymptotic expansions of rational functions against false theta functions. It is not the quantum-modular-forms chapter and the join must be broken. No existing ref() key matches it: grep of references.ts for '2205.01282' and for 'homological block' returns nothing, so id is null. This is the most valuable of the five mis-joins, because the corpus cites gukov-pei-putrov-vafa2017 (library/arxiv-1701.06567v2/1701.06567v2.pdf, also in this slice) at QOU/QBeta/StokesDTBPSBridge.lean:55 as a CONJECTURAL class field — and this document PROVES the relevant GPPV conjecture for a wide class. Corpus-grep before declaring the gap: docs/audits/, docs/coordination/, content/ and computations/ contain no reference to this arXiv id or to 'homological blocks', so no prior agent has already closed it.

keyResults.statement: For a wide class of plumbed 3-manifolds with negative-definite linking matrix, the WRT invariant is the radial limit of the corresponding homological block; the proof establishes vanishing of the weighted Gauss sums appearing in negative-degree coefficients of the blocks' asymptotic expansions.
keyResults.useForFolio: StokesDTBPSBridge.lean currently carries the GPPV identification as an ASSUMED class field. This document upgrades part of that assumption to a proved statement on a restricted class, so the bridge's epistemic tier could be sharpened — but only if 4_1's relevant 3-manifold is in the plumbed negative-definite class, which I have NOT checked. Until that is checked this is a citation to record, not a hypothesis to discharge.

proposedActions.rationale: It proves a conjecture the corpus currently assumes as a class field, and has no ref() entry. Create one; the ledger row keeps id null until then so the false join to the quantum-modular-forms key is not propagated.

Record what would have to be checked before this changes any epistemic tier: whether the knot complements / 3-manifolds the folio's A_omega argument uses fall inside this document's plumbed, negative-definite-linking-matrix class. If they do not, the GPPV identification stays conjectural for the folio's purposes and the bridge's class fields must remain as they are.
